title: Marianic Echoes Compat Pack
description: adds compatibility between Marianic Echoes and other End mods
body:
> **IMPORTANT: [MARIANIC ECHOES](https://modrinth.com/mod/marianic-echoes) IS REQUIRED FOR THIS RESOURCE PACK!!! GO INSTALL IT!**

I _**love**_ the End dimension.

and I _**love**_ mods that expand on it. especially this one called [Marianic Echoes](https://modrinth.com/mod/marianic-echoes).

but unfortunately, the textures in this mod aren't consistent with the textures of other mods. yes, I know Tac said she would add compatibility eventually but SHE'S **TAKING TOO LONG** (see below image)

![screenshot showcasing the lack of built-in compatibility](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/ca06a2b086aaff14f963b203c5c954bf7757fb64.png)
(note: it's actually been 6 months now, I'm too just lazy to update the image)

so I set out to fix that on my own.



that's all, go download the pack or something

<details>
<summary>Note</summary>

> _if Tac or anyone else wants me to take this pack down or something, **I'll do it ASAP**. just make sure to let me know!_

</details>
